title: Crispy Oven Baked Ground Turkey Tacos
reject_reason: Ground-turkey taco filling with black beans, corn and Mexican cheese in tortillas duplicates the saturated live turkey-taco family, especially loaded-ground-turkey-nacho-bake; the crispy-baked shell is a vehicle, not a distinct dinner, echoing the prior turkey-taco-lettuce-wraps ruling.
